author: reeinharddd
description: Visual documentation MCP server for AI agents: terminal, code, browser, Markdown, HTML, diffs, PDF, GIF, and documents.
name: SnapMCP

resources.name: snapmcp-capabilities
resources.title: SnapMCP capability manifest
resources.description: Compact, machine-readable catalog of snapmcp tools, limits, discovery surfaces, security defaults, and token policy.

tools.name: capture_terminal
tools.title: Capture terminal output
tools.description: Generate a styled terminal screenshot from text lines. Uses a detected terminal palette when available (Kitty, GNOME, Alacritty, WezTerm, and others) and otherwise falls back to the configured theme. Use for CLI tutorials, command output documentation, and terminal-based guides.

title.description: Window title shown in the terminal title bar (e.g., 'bash', 'zsh', 'git log')

lines.description: Lines to render. Prefix command prompts with '$ ' (or '# ' for root) for syntax-colored prompts. Other lines are rendered as output. Maximum 1000 lines.

output.description: Output filename (default: auto-generated as 'terminal-<timestamp>.png' or '.jpeg' based on SNAPMCP_FORMAT). Include extension to override format.

path.description: Absolute path of the saved image file

format.description: Format of the saved image file

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

tools.name: capture_code
tools.title: Capture highlighted code
tools.description: Generate a syntax-highlighted code screenshot using Shiki (300+ bundled languages and 27 themes). Supports inclusive startLine/endLine ranges and optional window chrome. Ideal for code documentation, tutorials, and sharing snippets with an IDE-like appearance.

language.description: Programming language for highlighting. Supports 300+ bundled Shiki languages, including typescript, javascript, python, rust, go, java, c, cpp, csharp, ruby, php, swift, kotlin, sql, json, yaml, markdown, html, css, bash, dockerfile, toml, xml, graphql, and many more. Use 'text' for plain text.

title.description: Window title shown in the title bar (e.g., 'src/main.ts', 'example.py')

startLine.description: First line number to show in the gutter (1-indexed). Use with endLine to show a code range.

endLine.description: Last line number to show in the gutter (1-indexed, inclusive). Must be >= startLine if both provided.

output.description: Output filename (default: auto-generated as 'code-<timestamp>.png' or '.jpeg' based on SNAPMCP_FORMAT). Include extension to override format.

path.description: Absolute path of the saved image file

format.description: Format of the saved image file

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

tools.name: capture_browser
tools.title: Capture a web page
tools.description: Take a screenshot of an HTTP(S) URL using headless Chromium. Uses Playwright's bundled Chromium by default; set SNAPMCP_CHROME_EXECUTABLE or the experimental SNAPMCP_CHROME_PROFILE to opt into a system Chrome or persistent profile. Explicit profile mode can send profile cookies and session state to the target site. SSRF protection is enabled by default and blocks private/local targets. Supports full-page or viewport captures.

url.description: URL to capture (http/https). Private and local IPv4/IPv6 targets, localhost variants, and hostnames resolving to private addresses are blocked when SSRF protection is enabled.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page (true) or the viewport (false).

output.description: Output filename (default: auto-generated as 'browser-<timestamp>.png' or '.jpeg' based on SNAPMCP_FORMAT). Include extension to override format.

path.description: Absolute path of the saved image file

format.description: Format of the saved image file

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

tools.name: capture_file
tools.title: Capture a source file
tools.description: Read a file and generate a syntax-highlighted screenshot with automatic language detection from file extension. Supports 300+ bundled Shiki languages. Requires SNAPMCP_ALLOWED_PATHS to be set for security (deny-all by default). Maximum file size 5MB.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the file to capture. Must be within SNAPMCP_ALLOWED_PATHS allowlist. Symlinks are resolved to prevent traversal.

startLine.description: First line number to capture (1-indexed, inclusive). Use with endLine to capture a specific range.

endLine.description: Last line number to capture (1-indexed, inclusive). Must be >= startLine if both provided. Defaults to end of file.

output.description: Output filename (default: auto-generated as 'file-<timestamp>.png' or '.jpeg' based on SNAPMCP_FORMAT). Include extension to override format.

path.description: Absolute path of the saved image file

format.description: Format of the saved image file

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

tools.name: capture_markdown
tools.title: Render Markdown
tools.description: Render GitHub-flavored Markdown as a styled document screenshot. Supports tables, task lists, and fenced code blocks with syntax highlighting. Raw HTML is escaped, JavaScript is disabled, and external resources are blocked. Maximum input 200KB.

markdown.description: Markdown content to render. Supports GFM tables, task lists, fenced code blocks, strikethrough, and autolinks. Raw HTML is escaped. Maximum 200KB.

title.description: Document title shown in the window title bar and as H1 if not present in markdown.

output.description: Output filename (default: auto-generated as 'markdown-<timestamp>.png' or '.jpeg' based on SNAPMCP_FORMAT). Include extension to override format.

path.description: Absolute path of the saved image file

format.description: Format of the saved image file

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

tools.name: capture_html
tools.title: Render HTML
tools.description: Render HTML/CSS as a screenshot in an isolated, JavaScript-disabled context. Inline styles and embedded data images are supported; scripts, frames, external stylesheets, and other external resources are removed or blocked. Maximum input 200KB.

html.description: HTML content to render. Active elements, event handlers, external references, and unsafe URL schemes are removed. Inline styles, <style> tags, and embedded data images work. Maximum 200KB.

title.description: Description for logging and window title (if window chrome enabled).

output.description: Output filename (default: auto-generated as 'html-<timestamp>.png' or '.jpeg' based on SNAPMCP_FORMAT). Include extension to override format.

path.description: Absolute path of the saved image file

format.description: Format of the saved image file

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

tools.name: capture_diff
tools.title: Capture a code diff
tools.description: Render a unified diff with color-coded additions (green) and deletions (red). Shows file headers, hunk markers, and context lines. Ideal for PR reviews, migration guides, and change documentation. Maximum input 500KB.

diff.description: Unified diff content (for example, output from 'git diff' or 'diff -u'). File headers (---/+++) and hunk markers (@@ -... +... @@) are rendered when present. Maximum 500KB.

output.description: Output filename (default: auto-generated as 'diff-<timestamp>.png' or '.jpeg' based on SNAPMCP_FORMAT). Include extension to override format.

path.description: Absolute path of the saved image file

format.description: Format of the saved image file

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

tools.name: capture_pdf
tools.title: Capture a URL as PDF
tools.description: Convert a URL to a print-quality PDF using headless Chromium. The complete paginated document is printed. Uses a system Chrome profile only when explicitly configured. SSRF protection is enabled by default (blocks private IPs and localhost).

url.description: URL to convert to PDF (http/https). Must pass SSRF validation: private and local addresses are blocked and requests are revalidated.

width.description: Viewport width in pixels (320-3840) for responsive rendering.

height.description: Viewport height in pixels (240-4096) for responsive rendering.

output.description: Output filename (default: auto-generated as 'pdf-<timestamp>.pdf'). Must end in .pdf.

path.description: Absolute path of the saved PDF

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

tools.name: capture_batch
tools.title: Capture multiple artifacts
tools.description: Capture multiple items in a single call. Each capture is processed sequentially with its own parameters. Use for batch documentation generation (e.g., capture terminal output, code file, and browser screenshot together). Maximum 10 captures per call.

lines.description: Lines to render. Prefix with '$ ' for prompts.

language.description: Programming language (typescript, python, rust, go, etc.)

filePath.description: Absolute path to file (must be in SNAPMCP_ALLOWED_PATHS)

captures.description: Array of captures to process. Each capture specifies its type and type-specific parameters.

output.description: Output directory (default: SNAPMCP_DIR). Captures saved as individual files.

type.description: Capture type that produced the file

path.description: Absolute path of the saved file

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

captures.description: One entry per saved capture, in capture order

tools.name: capture_sequence
tools.title: Capture a process sequence
tools.description: Capture ordered process steps as individual image files and optionally compile them into a GIF. Each step has typed capture parameters plus stepNumber and label. When GIF output is requested, frames are rendered as PNG. Maximum 60 steps.

lines.description: Lines to render. Prefix with '$ ' for prompts.

language.description: Programming language (typescript, python, rust, go, etc.)

filePath.description: Absolute path to file (must be in SNAPMCP_ALLOWED_PATHS)

steps.description: Array of steps to capture. Each step specifies its capture type, type-specific parameters, plus optional stepNumber and label.

compileGif.description: Compile frames into an animated GIF (requires at least 2 steps)

frameDelay.description: Frame delay in milliseconds for GIF (10-5000). Default 800ms.

output.description: Output directory (default: SNAPMCP_DIR). Steps saved as individual files, GIF as sequence-<timestamp>.gif

type.description: Capture type that produced the file

path.description: Absolute path of the saved file

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

steps.description: One entry per captured step, in step order

gifPath.description: Absolute path of the compiled GIF, when requested

gifBytes.description: Size of the compiled GIF in bytes

tools.name: capture_gif
tools.title: Capture an animated GIF
tools.description: Create an animated GIF from 2-60 sequential captures. Frames are rendered as PNG, compiled into a GIF, and removed after encoding. loop=true repeats forever; loop=false plays once. Maximum canvas 8192x8192.

title.description: Name for the GIF (used in default filename)

lines.description: Lines to render. Prefix with '$ ' for prompts.

language.description: Programming language (typescript, python, rust, go, etc.)

filePath.description: Absolute path to file (must be in SNAPMCP_ALLOWED_PATHS)

captures.description: Array of frames to capture. Each frame specifies its capture type and type-specific parameters. Minimum 2, maximum 60 frames.

frameDelay.description: Frame delay in milliseconds for GIF (10-5000). Default 800ms.

loop.description: Whether the GIF loops infinitely (true) or plays once (false)

output.description: Output filename (default: auto-generated as '<title>-<timestamp>.gif'). Must end in .gif

path.description: Absolute path of the saved GIF

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

frames.description: Number of frames in the animation

tools.name: capture_document
tools.title: Capture a visual document
tools.description: Create a document with embedded step-by-step captures. Each capture is rendered as an image and embedded in the document with optional captions. Output formats: markdown (with image references), html (self-contained with base64 images), pdf (print-quality), pptx (editable PowerPoint deck), or docx (editable Word document). Maximum 30 captures per document; 25 MB per embedded image and 75 MB total.

lines.description: Lines to render. Prefix with '$ ' for prompts.

caption.description: Caption for this capture in the document

language.description: Programming language (typescript, python, rust, go, etc.)

caption.description: Caption for this capture in the document

filePath.description: Absolute path to file (must be in SNAPMCP_ALLOWED_PATHS)

caption.description: Caption for this capture in the document
Caption for this capture in the document
Caption for this capture in the document
Caption for this capture in the document

captures.description: Array of captures to embed. Each specifies capture type, type-specific parameters, and optional caption.

format.description: Output document format: markdown (image refs), html (self-contained), pdf (print-quality), pptx (editable PowerPoint), docx (editable Word)

includeTimestamps.description: Include capture timestamps in the document

output.description: Output filename (default: auto-generated as 'document-<timestamp>.md/.html/.pdf/.pptx/.docx'). Extension should match format.

path.description: Absolute path of the saved document

bytes.description: Size of the saved file in bytes

captureCount.description: Number of captures embedded in the document

tools.name: snapmcp-hint
tools.title: Find the right snapmcp tool
tools.description: Find the right snapmcp tool by natural-language intent, or get concise setup, security, sandbox, agent, and token guidance. Use when tool selection is unclear or before loading the full documentation.

topic.description: Legacy named topic: init, doctor, browser, themes, output, security, sandbox, gif, document, batch, tokens, agents, discovery, or code-mode.

query.description: Natural-language intent to search, such as 'website screenshot', 'animated before and after', 'pdf export', or 'read a source file'.

kind.description: Kind of guidance returned: ranked matches, a setup topic, or the overview

query.description: Query or topic the guidance answers

matches.description: Ranked tool matches; empty when the answer is not a search
